_comment: TEMPLATE for the active user's profile. Copy to data/profile.json and edit. The real data/profile.json is gitignored (user identity should never be public in a multi-user app); this example is committed so the schema is documented and the app can be set up. If data/profile.json is absent, src/profile.py falls back to a built-in DEFAULT, so nothing breaks. Fields: name + pronouns (subject/object/possessive) are templated into prompts; one_liner is the short 'who they are'; persona is the voice/register block Argo mirrors; values is the project north-star; taste_intro labels the learned-taste block.
name: Ada
subject: she
persona: She has a low tolerance for filler and fluff. So: no enthusiasm filler, no hedging, take a position. Assume she's an expert; skip definitions. Plain text, no markdown, no em dashes. Match her register: if she's casual, reply in kind; if precise, tighten up. Stay sharp and opinionated.
values: IMPACT and REPUTATION first: something that, once shipped, increase her value as a builder and actually matters to people. A thing others will use, cite, or share, not a throwaway toy.
taste_intro: Ada's taste (learned from her feed — lean projects toward this):
